test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Sam is sitting second to the right of Krish. Vishal is sitting second to the right of Sam. Savio is sitting third to the right of Sam. Michelle is the immediate neighbour of Sam and Krish. Dixon is sitting third to the right of Krish. Who is sitting between Vishal and Krish?
solution:
**Given :** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation :**

1) Sam is sitting second to the right of Krish.

2) Vishal is sitting second to the right of Sam.

3) Savio is sitting third to the right of Sam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a4ae6893c86243e1f283e8a709f80ebed323fd8972377bdabb2c25eb501e0a.png] 

4) Michelle is the immediate neighbour of Sam and Krish.

5) Dixon is sitting third to the right of Krish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1d868a6a1e03f259436972b50e8e8598f49f59f4be1fbdfd29d484538e30d70.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Savio is sitting between Vishal and Krish.

Hence, **"Savio"** is the correct answer.
